def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # strip whitespace / fix label variants for text columns
    for col in ['species', 'island', 'sex']:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = df[col].apply(lambda x: x.strip() if isinstance(x, str) else x)
            df[col] = df[col].replace('', pd.NA)
    # ensure numeric columns are numeric (handles text_number)
    for col in ['bill_length_mm', 'bill_depth_mm', 'flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g', 'year']:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')
    # fix negative flipper_length_mm (abs value is within 170-235)
    if 'flipper_length_mm' in df.columns:
        df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
        # any remaining out of range set to NA (not needed for question but cleans)
        df.loc[(df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170) | (df['flipper_length_mm'] > 235), 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    # fix body_mass_g out_of_range: 5050000 is 1000x too large
    if 'body_mass_g' in df.columns:
        # correct obvious factor-1000 error
        mask = df['body_mass_g'] > 6500
        df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000
        # any still out of range -> invalid -> NA
        df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    # also clean bill_length_mm out of range if any
    if 'bill_length_mm' in df.columns:
        df.loc[(df['bill_length_mm'] < 30) | (df['bill_length_mm'] > 60), 'bill_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    return df

def answer(df):
    # total body mass per species
    d = df.copy()
    # ensure numeric
    if 'body_mass_g' in d.columns:
        d['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(d['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    d = d.dropna(subset=['species', 'body_mass_g'])
    # drop missing group keys (empty strings)
    d = d[d['species'].astype(str).str.strip() != '']
    grouped = d.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].sum()
    result = {}
    for k, v in grouped.items():
        if pd.isna(k) or str(k).strip() == '':
            continue
        # convert to int if whole number for clean output
        fv = float(v)
        result[str(k)] = int(round(fv)) if fv.is_integer() else float(fv)
    return result
